result.keywords: This article examines how human-in-the-loop approaches can support fairness-aware machine learning in complex and sensitive domains, with a focus on mental health and related social media contexts. We synthesize practical lessons from prior projects, emphasizing the role of expert judgment, stakeholder feedback, and iterative model inspection in addressing bias, uncertainty, and ethical risk. The discussion highlights opportunities and challenges for deploying AI systems that balance predictive performance with societal significance and responsible oversight.
result.title: Human-Guided Fairness in Sensitive Machine Learning Systems: Lessons from Mental Health Applications.
